name: Kyouen Etsuraku no Requiem
original_name: 狂宴 悦楽のレクイエム
source:
Yasuto Hirabayashi's grandfather died and left him a diary. There was written about the woman and the ring that he could not attain. How is it connected to the classmates that who decided to spend vacations in a mystery mansion?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-september-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
平林康人的祖父去世后，给他留下了一本日记。日记里写着祖父始终未能得到的女人和戒指。这一切与决定在神秘宅邸度假的同学们有什么关系？

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-september-1997.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
